FIELDS.NAME: Color Oasis Paint & Wallpaper Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Color Oasis Paint & Wallpaper Store specializes in the retail of high-quality paint, wallpaper, and related home improvement supplies. Our operations are focused on providing a wide selection of products to residential and commercial customers, enhancing their interior design projects. We offer in-store color matching and consultation services, enabling customers to make informed choices for their decorating needs. The store promotes eco-friendly products, including low-VOC paint options, and conducts workshops to educate customers on various techniques. Our inventory management systems ensure that we maintain a reliable stock of popular brands and specialty items, while our commitment to safety includes training our staff in the handling and disposal of hazardous materials. Color Oasis adheres strictly to all applicable environmental regulations, ensuring safe practices throughout our retail operations, which are conducted in a secure location equipped with necessary fire protection systems.
